title: Sewing and Finishing Support Corner
description: One static sewing support corner from the original tailoring scene program. Four complete existing props form a machine-and-chair position, separate low thread-spool storage, and a side ironing station. The whole unchanged lockstitch workstation, two-tier partly occupied spool rack, complete dining chair, and complete ironing-board-and-iron kit retain every original mesh, local POSITION/NORMAL payload, PBR material and internal hierarchy. The chair uses the original workstation documented relative placement (-0.10,-0.48,0) with a 180 degree turn; other units remain visibly separate. Only whole-instance translations, exact quarter-turn wrappers and one finite scene-only floor are new. One scene and zero new independent models. No occupant, actual sewing or ironing, moving needle/pedal, electric or heating operation, material processing, ergonomics, accessibility, load or safety certification.
